thought.text: All evidence is in. One final confirmation that the JS entry points serve, then I'll summarize.

reasoning_content:
All verified:
- The Vite client is being served at `/vite-dev/@vite/client` → 200 text/javascript via the Rails proxy.
- The served HTML references the Vite entry point (application.js, vue.js) — a Vue SPA is being loaded.

Let me quickly confirm that the entry points also return 200, then I'll wrap up. Actually, this is enough. Just to be safe, I'll check the entry point script once and then finish up.
